task_description: Renderer Lambda を PDF 経由 PNG 変換に切り替えて A4 自動フィットを実現する

verification.summary: pnpm typecheck passes, pnpm test passes (18/18 tests including 9 renderer tests). Tests cover PDF generation, multi-page PNG conversion, S3 upload, error handling, empty page guard, pdfToPng exception handling, undefined content guard, and backward compatibility.
